1. Data Collection and AI Training

Ailytics processes data collected or generated through the use of Ailytics software, including business contact information (such as name and business email addresses), video feeds, images, alerts and associated metadata (including timestamps and sensor data). Video feeds, images and associated metadata may contain personal data as defined in the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (“PDPA”). For real-time safety monitoring, inference, alert generation and delivery of alerts or associated media to you through your use of Ailytics software, Ailytics acts as a data intermediary on your behalf and processes personal data provided by you on your documented instructions.

There may be instances where Ailytics manually selects a limited subset of images, short video clips and necessary associated metadata for AI model training, benchmarking, testing, or improvement purposes (the “Selected Training Data”). Where Ailytics does so, Ailytics acts as an organisation in its own right for those purposes. You are responsible for ensuring that your collection and disclosure of the relevant data to Ailytics are lawful and that affected individuals receive any notices, signage or induction information required by applicable law.

Customer data processed for real-time monitoring, including alerts, media files and associated metadata, will be retained only for as long as necessary to provide the services and no longer than the applicable Paid Term under the written agreement, unless a longer period is required by law. Upon expiry or termination, Ailytics will, at your election and subject to applicable law, return or securely delete that data; and any remaining data in our backups will be deleted within seven days. Should any customer data be selected by Ailytics to become Selected Training Data, such customer data will not be deleted to the extent permitted by and governed by any applicable data-processing clauses and law.

6. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

This EULA shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Singapore.

Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this EULA, including any question regarding its existence, validity or termination (a “Dispute”), must first be submitted for mediation at the Singapore Mediation Centre (“SMC”) in accordance with the SMC Mediation Procedure in force for the time being. Either party may submit a request to mediate to the SMC upon which the other party will be bound to participate in the mediation within 45 days thereof. Each party shall be represented by senior executive personnel with authority to negotiate and settle the Dispute. Unless otherwise agreed by the parties, the mediator(s) will be appointed by SMC. The mediation will take place in Singapore in the English language and the parties agree to be bound by any settlement agreement reached. If no settlement is reached within 60 days of submission to the SMC (or such longer period as the parties may agree), the mediation shall be deemed to have failed.

If the Dispute is not resolved by mediation, the Dispute shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (“SIAC”) in accordance with the Arbitration Rules of the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (“SIAC Rules”) for the time being in force, which rules are deemed to be incorporated by reference in this clause. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore. The tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator. The language of arbitration shall be English. The law governing this arbitration agreement shall be the laws of Singapore. No party may commence arbitration unless it has first complied with the mediation requirements set out above and mediation has been deemed to have failed.

All data collected through the use of Ailytics software is stored and processed solely on Ailytics servers. By default, Ailytics hosts its platform in Singapore. Any transfer of data outside Singapore will be made only in accordance with applicable law and any applicable data-processing clauses.
